name: @ionyx-apps/cli
description: Ionyx Framework CLI - High-performance desktop apps with Rust and WebGPU, featuring detailed template architectures

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run copy-binary
scripts.copy-binary: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const platform=require('os').platform();const arch=require('os').arch();let binaryName='ionyx';if(platform==='linux'){binaryName=arch==='arm64'?'ionyx-linux-arm64':'ionyx-linux-x64';}else if(platform==='darwin'){binaryName=arch==='arm64'?'ionyx-macos-arm64':'ionyx-macos-x64';}else if(platform==='win32'){binaryName='ionyx-win.exe';}const src=path.join('ionyx-cli/target/release','ionyx'+(platform==='win32'?'.exe':''));const dest=path.join('bin',binaryName);if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('✅ CLI binary copied to:'+dest);}else{console.error('❌ Source binary not found:'+src);process.exit(1);}"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean:templates && npm run build:all && (upx --best --lzma bin/ionyx* || echo 'UPX not available, skipping compression')
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const platform=require('os').platform();const arch=require('os').arch();let binaryName='ionyx';if(platform==='linux'){binaryName=arch==='arm64'?'ionyx-linux-arm64':'ionyx-linux-x64';}else if(platform==='darwin'){binaryName=arch==='arm64'?'ionyx-macos-arm64':'ionyx-macos-x64';}else if(platform==='win32'){binaryName='ionyx-win.exe';}const src=path.join('bin',binaryName);const destPath=path.join('/usr/lib/node_modules/@ionyx-apps/cli/bin','ionyx');if(fs.existsSync(src)&&process.platform!=='win32'){require('child_process').spawnSync('sudo',['mkdir','-p','/usr/lib/node_modules/@ionyx-apps/cli/bin'],{stdio:'inherit'});require('child_process').spawnSync('sudo',['cp',src,destPath],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('✅ Global CLI binary installed');}"

author: Ionyx Apps <info@ionyx.app>
